_note: FL15 fragment (domain D7). domains.D7 is the domain record (ranges narrowed to the flags that are storage: $0500-$0507 and $0510-$051F). flags: one full record per index in use: the five boss reward flags $0500-$0504 (1280-1284), the five ability flags that have a setter and a reader ($0510 1296, $0511 1297, $0514 1300, $0515 1301, $0516 1302) and the three Shadow slots the Status tab tests but nothing sets ($0518-$051A 1304-1306). proposals: 1298 ($0512, Spin Dash) is read in two groups (system and great_wall: gw85_spin_dash_gate), so FL31 writes its record. _no_use lists every other index of the domain with the search that found no use. Evidence offsets: the {n} tag of the asm line, or, for tables/scene_actors.asm rows (untagged file), the ROM offset of the 7- or 9-byte record decoded from rebuilt/Illusion of Gaia.smc (plans/flags/tools/fl15_query.mjs bosses/darkspace, 0 mismatches), and the ROM offset of AbilitySceneTable (584538, bytes checked against the ROM).

D7.name: boss reward / ability unlock
D7.lifecycle: Byte $0AA0 (flags $0500-$0507) and the word $0AA2-$0AA3 (flags $0510-$051F, also abilityBitmask) lie in the save block $0A00-$0BFB. ClearSceneState zeroes only $0A00-$0A01; ClearAllWramFlags (WorldMapController {238336}, st68_kara {438261}, sp58_red_eye {426502}) and the inline loop of game_over_sequence ({54988}-{55002}) zero exactly $0A80-$0A9F, one byte below $0AA0, so a set bit survives scene changes, the world map and a game over. Boot zero-fills WRAM and SystemInit clears the low byte of abilityBitmask again ({32946}); DiaryNewGameStart writes neither byte (FL10), so a new game starts from the boot zeros. The range shipped for D7 is narrowed to the 8 + 16 bits that have storage: $0508-$050F ($0AA1) is unassigned and $0520-$059F is not flag storage ($0AA4-$0AB3 hold state words, FL10 byte map).
D7.access: Boss flags: TestWramFlag_Offset100 / SetWramFlag_Offset100 (index AND 7, base $0100 on wramFlags $0A80), called by boss_clear_reward_handler ({49883}, {49928}) and tested at spawn by the six lair actors ({695049}, {708981}, {717345}, {717790}, {754027}, {763580}). Ability flags: TestFlag_0510 (+$0510, one call: TestAbilityFlag {190952}) and direct 16-bit access of abilityBitmask $0AA2 (31 inventory rows in 8 files: one live setter, sE6_gaia AbilityOrbActor {584379}/{584382}). No COP flag operand, no scene-meta gate and no other helper reaches $0500-$051F.

meanings.name: sys_will_psycho_dash_unlocked
meanings.summary: Will owns Psycho Dash (form 0, slot 0; abilityBitmask $0AA2 bit 0, mask $01).

effects.set: Will's attack gate (BIT #$0005 on abilityBitmask) passes, so a held attack charges and releasing it launches Psycho Dash; the Status tab shows Psycho Dash for Will (row 0 and its description); the Dark Space of Itory Village (source scene $15) dies at spawn because the bit is already owned.
effects.clear: Will cannot start a charged attack unless Spin Dash (bit 2) is set; the Status tab hides row 0 for Will; the Itory Village Dark Space spawns the ability orb that grants it.

meanings.notes: Index = characterForm*4 + slot = 0 (TestAbilityFlag). The only live setter is AbilityOrbActor (the grant ORs the table bit $01 into abilityBitmask after the player stands in the statue zone, forced to Will first). Bit 0 is read only through the combined gate $0005 (Psycho Dash or Spin Dash): no code tests bit 0 alone except the Status tab and the orb's own owned check. The unused prototype dark_rewards (never placed) grants the same bit for source scene $15. Name is the in-game ability name (sE6_gaia string 'Psycho Dash'); the community 'Psycho Dash 01' bit order matches.

meanings.name: sys_will_psycho_slider_unlocked

effects.set: CheckRunAttack lets Will's run attack proceed: with the attack button down and a speed of at least 3 on one axis the slide (RunAttackEW / RunAttackNS) starts; the Status tab shows Psycho Slider (row 1); the Mu West Dark Space (source scene $62) dies at spawn.
effects.clear: The run attack never starts (CheckRunAttack returns); the Status tab hides row 1 for Will; the Mu West Dark Space spawns the ability orb.

meanings.notes: The run attack also requires characterForm 0, actor $10 bit $0080 clear and playerFlags $1000 clear (not on a slope). Setter: AbilityOrbActor in scene $62 (mu_west, scene_actors row #04). The unused dark_rewards prototype grants bit $02 for source scene $62.

effects.clear: Freedan cannot start a charged attack unless Earthquaker (bit 6) is set; the Status tab hides row 0 for Freedan; the scene $42 Dark Space spawns the ability orb.

meanings.notes: Index = 1*4 + 0 = 4 (ability index 5 in the name tables). Bit 4 is read only through the combined gate $0050 (Dark Friar or Earthquaker): the charge release launches Dark Friar without testing bit 4 again (LaunchDarkFriar {178371}). Bit 3 ($08, flag $0513) is unused, so Freedan's bits start at bit 4. Setter: AbilityOrbActor in scene $42; the unused dark_rewards prototype grants bit $10 for source scene $42.

meanings.name: sys_freedan_aura_barrier_unlocked
meanings.summary: Freedan owns Aura Barrier (form 1, slot 1; abilityBitmask $0AA2 bit 5, mask $20).

effects.set: After Freedan's 100-frame charge, the attack takes the extended branch: releasing launches Dark Friar, a D-pad press returns without action, L or R launches Aura Barrier (which needs the player to stand still); the Status tab shows Aura Barrier (row 1); the Mountain Temple vine maze Dark Space (source scene $A7) dies at spawn.
effects.clear: After the charge the attack waits only for release and launches Dark Friar; the Status tab hides row 1 for Freedan; the scene $A7 Dark Space spawns the ability orb.

meanings.notes: Index = 1*4 + 1 = 5. Setter: AbilityOrbActor in scene $A7 (kress_maze, row #03); the unused dark_rewards prototype grants bit $20 for source scene $A7.

meanings.name: sys_freedan_earthquaker_unlocked
meanings.summary: Freedan owns Earthquaker (form 1, slot 2; abilityBitmask $0AA2 bit 6, mask $40).

effects.set: Freedan's ledge-jump drop attack is available (CheckLedgeJumpAttack: form 1, attack pressed while falling starts LedgeJumpDropAttack); bit 6 also passes Freedan's attack gate (BIT #$0050); the Status tab shows Earthquaker (row 2); the Angkor Wat inner east Dark Space (source scene $B8) dies at spawn.
effects.clear: No drop attack; Freedan's attack gate depends on Dark Friar (bit 4); the Status tab hides row 2 for Freedan; the scene $B8 Dark Space spawns the ability orb.

meanings.notes: Index = 1*4 + 2 = 6. The charged-attack code launches Dark Friar on release whichever of bits 4 or 6 opened the gate, so Earthquaker alone would also let Freedan charge and fire Dark Friar although bit 4 is clear; whether that state can occur depends on the order in which the Dark Spaces are visited, which is not evidence here. Setter: AbilityOrbActor in scene $B8; the unused dark_rewards prototype grants bit $40 for source scene $B8.
